vocab.example: We exchanged pleasantries before getting into work talk.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi trao đổi vài câu xã giao trước khi vào chuyện công việc.

vocab.example: I hit it off with the new hire right away in the pantry.

vocab.example: We found a common interest in coffee and football.

vocab.meaning_vi: lời mời ngỏ, luôn chào đón
vocab.example: Consider this an open invitation to join us for coffee anytime.

vocab.example: Can we have a quick chat in the pantry later?

vocab.example: A warm smile makes new colleagues feel welcome.
vocab.example_vi: Một nụ cười thân thiện khiến đồng nghiệp mới cảm thấy được chào đón.

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: Hi, I don't think we've met — I'm Nam from engineering.

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Nam. I'm Linh from marketing.

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: Nice. Can we have a quick chat while I make some coffee?

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: Sure! It's nice to finally put a face to a name — I've seen your emails.

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: Ha, good to know. So what do you do for fun outside work?

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: I love running and reading. What about you?

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: Running too, actually. Looks like we have a common interest.

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: Small world! I think we hit it off pretty fast.

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: Agreed. I really enjoy this kind of informal chat during the day.

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: Same here. Consider this an open invitation to join us for lunch sometime.

lines.speaker: Nam (engineering)
lines.text: I'd love that, thanks for the warm smile and the welcome.

lines.speaker: Linh (marketing)
lines.text: Anytime, Nam. See you around the pantry.
